Site Managers    Add Site Manager  Users
Site Managers are responsible to Submit Transaction Packets from the site that they are assigned to.
 
Area Managers    Add Area Manager  Users
Area Managers oversee multiple Sites.
They can Submit packets from a Site if the Site Manager is not available.
They receive notifications if Packets are Rejected or an Alert is raised from a Site they have responsiblity for.
 
Auditors    Add Auditor  Users
Auditors manage the review and posting workflows for Packets that are Submitted from the sites they are assigned to.
 
Accountants    Add Accountant  Users
Accountants have full rights to submit, review and process all Packets for any site as well as manage Companies and Users. They can be added to multiple Organizations.
 
Organization Administrators    Add Org Admin  Users
Organizational Administrators have full rights to submit, review and process all Packets for any site.
